messages:
Sara: Following the cache-eviction PM, let's assign owners for the action items and attach Jira tickets. Short list: infra TTL fix, alerting + dashboards, runbook & KB, fallback policy evaluation, retro notes + customer comms. Please claim by EOD.

Ajay: I'll pick infra TTL fix. Will open ticket and include acceptance criteria. ETA end of next week (2026-03-27).

ops-bot: RED-4130 created by Ajay - 'infra: validate and enforce TTL bounds; add unit + integration tests' https://jira.redwood/RED-4130

Mike: I'll own alerting and dashboard updates. Creating RED-4131. Need metric names from Ajay and a sample trace.

Ajay: I'll add metric docs to RED-4130 and link the repro commands: ``make repro-eviction`` and ``pytest tests/test_ttl_bounds.py``.

Rachel: I'll take runbook + KB (RED-4132). Will include playbook steps, verification checks, and escalation contacts. Plan due 2026-04-03.

Luis: Suggest a recurring-incident tracker ticket to monitor similar spikes monthly. I'll start RED-4133 as a placeholder and set a monthly review cadence. If no one objects, I'll own it.

Sara: Proposed RACI: Ajay R for infra, Mike A for alerts, Rachel A for docs, Sara A for comms, Luis I/backup. Agree?

Mike: Agree. Also request a 30m sync with Ajay tomorrow 11:00 PST to align metrics and alert thresholds.

Ajay: 11:00 PST works. I'll bring reproducer and perf-smoke scripts.

ops-bot: Reminder: oncall handoff next week. If rollout spans rotation, please add backup owner.

Sara: I'll take retro notes + draft customer comms (RED-4134) due 2026-03-29. Will coordinate with support on wording.

Mike: If Ajay needs help with rollout verification during my oncall rotation, Luis can cover. I'll mark RED-4131 with a backup assignee.

Luis: Will review RED-4130 context and be ready to step in. Adding a calendar block for handoff.

Ajay: Adding PR checklist to RED-4130: tests, perf baseline, and eviction-rate snapshot post-deploy.

Rachel: Runbook acceptance criteria: clear steps, smoke test commands, expected metrics, and rollback instructions. I'll include contact matrix.

Sara: OK team — I'll post a follow-up in the PM doc and schedule a 48h check-in thread. If anyone misses their ETA, flag here so we can reassign. :thumbsup:
